1879059893.name: Controlled Burn
1879059893.desc: Briefly increases damage, Power regen, and attack speed.\n\nAdds 1 Fervour Pip every 5 seconds.

1879064245.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Raven)
1879064245.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879064373.name: Penetrating Shot
1879064373.desc: A damaging shot that pierces enemy mitigations.

1879072565.name: Stealth
1879072565.desc:
You can prowl beneath the notice of all but the keenest eyes, waiting to strike.

<rgb=#FF7700>In Flayer: Brute
Increases the application chance of your brute bonuses.</rgb>

1879102645.name: Fray the Edge
1879102645.desc: Taunts the enemy into lowering its defences, increasing the chance of a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nFellowship Manoeuvre chance increases with each use.

1879102773.name: Tactics Signal
1879102773.desc: Extends Tactics fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879111733.name: Burn Hot
1879111733.desc: Drawing upon deep reserves, you let fly with great strength and precision.

1879139381.name: Headbutt
1879139381.desc: Your foes will fall to your furious brow.

1879215029.name: Good Map to Lugazag
1879215029.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Lugazag.

1879218229.name: Echoes of Battle
1879218229.desc: This chant recalls great deeds done in battle, demoralizing your foe.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill must target an enemy and is only usable in Melody.</rgb>

1879221557.name: Improved Cry of the Chorus (Dissonance)
1879221557.desc: This skill provides you with three damage ballad bonus effects allowing access to Anthems and Codas. It also breaks any silence effects on you and provides you with a short term immunity to silence.

1879222197.name: Good Map to Tírith Rhaw
1879222197.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Tírith Rhaw.

1879244853.name: Lancer's Charge
1879244853.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Red Dawn Discipline your melee damage is increased.

1879245621.name: Debate
1879245621.desc:
<rgb=#66ffff>In Rohirrim</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>A debate on the nature of the People of Rohan provides you with a nearer bond with friendly targets around you.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Riddermark</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>One should take care when debating the nature of the Lands of Rohan with a Rune-keeper else they find themselves wishing the land would loosen its grasp upon them.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Red Dawn</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>One should be careful when debating the ruin and wrath wrought by the Red Dawn, else it shall find a way to vist ruin upon them.</rgb>

1879254069.name: Keen Strike
1879254069.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879322037.name: Broad Thrash - Tier 3
1879322037.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

1879338933.name: Blood-red Bat
1879338933.desc: Summons a friendly, blood red bat.

1879380789.name: Escape Clause
1879380789.desc:
After a successful Fellowship Manoeuvre, reset the cooldowns of:
Aim
Location is Everything
Touch and Go
Knives Out
All skills in the Critical Response chain.

1879406133.name: Muster in Limlók
1879406133.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Limlók

1879415861.name: Ill Omened Hound
1879415861.desc: Summons a hound painstakingly costumed as Raugshad the Ravener.

1879420853.name: Silver Chipmunk
1879420853.desc: Summons a bright chipmunk to keep you company.

1879465525.name: Slate Jerboa
1879465525.desc: Summons a friendly slate jerboa to accompany you on your journeys.

1879469749.name: Rummage: Scrap of Music
1879469749.desc: A well-preserved scrap of an ancient tune.

1879490741.name: Furious Claws
1879490741.desc: Your companion cuts through multiple foes with razor-sharp claws, leaving them bleeding.

1879491509.name: Muster at Jirush
1879491509.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Jirush in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879506741.name: Legacy of the Witch-king
1879506741.desc: Your devotion to the Witch-king is rewarded with enduring vigour.

1879508533.name: Brown Oryx
1879508533.desc: Summons a swift brown oryx to accompany you on your adventures.

1879529269.name: Drop the Visage of Gil-galad
1879529269.desc: Drop the Visage of Gil-galad relic.
